verse.verse_1: When the forthcoming event does occur.
verse.verse_2: Then none will be able to deny its occurrence.
verse.verse_3: The event will be abasing some, and exalting some.
verse.verse_4: When the earth will tremble, shivering.
verse.verse_5: And the mountains will be crushed, blown to bits.
verse.verse_6: So they will become like fine dust, scattered in a shaft of light.
verse.verse_7: And you will become divided into three categories.
verse.verse_8: So those on the right – how (fortunate) are those on the right!
verse.verse_9: And those on the left – how (wretched) are those on the left!
verse.verse_10: And those who surpassed have indeed excelled.
verse.verse_11: It is they who are the close ones.
verse.verse_12: They are in Gardens of peace.
verse.verse_13: A large group from the earlier generations.
verse.verse_14: And a few from the latter.
verse.verse_16: Reclining on them, facing each other.
verse.verse_18: Carrying bowls and pitchers – and cups filled with wine flowing before them.
verse.verse_19: Their heads shall not ache with it, nor shall they lose their senses.
verse.verse_20: And fruits that they may like.
verse.verse_21: And meat of birds that they may wish.
verse.verse_24: The reward for what they did.
verse.verse_25: They will not hear any useless speech in it, or any sin.
verse.verse_27: And those on the right – how (fortunate) are those on the right!
verse.verse_33: That will neither finish, nor ever be stopped.
verse.verse_35: We have indeed developed these women with an excellent development.
verse.verse_37: The beloved of their husbands, of one age.
verse.verse_39: A large group from the earlier generations.
verse.verse_40: And a large group from the latter.
verse.verse_41: And those on the left – how (wretched) are those on the left!
verse.verse_42: In scorching wind and boiling hot water.
verse.verse_43: And in the shadow of a burning smoke.
verse.verse_44: Which is neither cool nor is for respect.
verse.verse_45: Indeed they were among favours before this.
verse.verse_46: And were stubborn upon the great sin (of disbelief).
verse.verse_47: And they used to say, “When we are dead and have turned into dust and bones, will we surely be raised again?”
verse.verse_49: Proclaim, “Without doubt all – the former and the latter.”
verse.verse_50: “They will all be gathered together – on the appointed time of the known day.”
verse.verse_51: Then indeed you, the astray, the deniers –
verse.verse_52: You will indeed eat from the Zaqqum tree.
verse.verse_53: Then will fill your bellies with it.
verse.verse_54: And upon it, you will drink the hot boiling water.
verse.verse_55: Drinking the way thirsty camels drink.
verse.verse_56: This is their reception on the Day of Justice.
verse.verse_57: It is We Who created you, so why do you not accept the truth?
verse.verse_58: So what is your opinion regarding the semen you discharge?
verse.verse_59: Do you make a human out of it, or is it We Who create?
verse.verse_60: It is We Who have ordained death among you, and We have not been beaten –
verse.verse_61: In the matter of exchanging you for others, and to transform you into what you do not know.
verse.verse_62: And you have indeed learnt about the first creation, so why do you not ponder?
verse.verse_63: So what is your opinion regarding what you sow?
verse.verse_64: Is it you who cultivate it, or is it We Who develop it?
verse.verse_65: If We will We can make it like dry trampled hay, so you would keep crying out.
verse.verse_68: So what is your opinion regarding the water that you drink?
verse.verse_69: Is it you who caused it to descend from the cloud, or is it We Who cause it to descend?
verse.verse_70: If We will We can make it bitter, so why do you not give thanks?
verse.verse_71: So what is your opinion regarding the fire which you kindle?
verse.verse_72: Is it you who grew its tree, or is it We Who create?
verse.verse_73: We have made it as a reminder of hell and as a utility for travellers in the jungle.
verse.verse_74: Therefore (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him) proclaim the Purity of the name of your Lord, the Greatest.
verse.verse_75: So I swear by the setting places of the stars.
verse.verse_76: And that is indeed a tremendous oath, if you understand.
verse.verse_77: This is indeed the noble Qur’an.
verse.verse_79: None may touch it, except with ablution.
verse.verse_80: Sent down by the Lord Of The Creation.
verse.verse_81: So is this the matter regarding which you laze?
verse.verse_82: And you make its denial your share?
verse.verse_83: So why was it not, when the soul reaches up to the throat, –
verse.verse_84: Whereas you watch at that moment!
verse.verse_85: And We are nearer to him than you are, but you cannot see.
verse.verse_86: So why is it not, that if you are not to be repaid, –
verse.verse_87: That you bring it back, if you are truthful?
verse.verse_88: Then if the dying one is of those having proximity, –
verse.verse_89: Then is relief, and flowers – and Gardens of peace.
verse.verse_90: And if he is of those on the right, –
verse.verse_91: Then upon you is the greetings of peace (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), from those on the right.
verse.verse_92: And if he is from the deniers, the astray, –
verse.verse_93: Then his reception is the hot boiling water.
verse.verse_94: And a hurling into the blazing fire.
verse.verse_95: This is indeed an utmost certainty.
verse.verse_96: Therefore (O dear Prophet Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him) proclaim the Purity of the name of your Lord, the Greatest.
